evidence.decision: Decides whether interruption is warranted from urgency, reversibility and prior intent, preserving the explicitly requested destruction/default exception.
evidence.artifact: Requires exact copy, trigger, action roles/order/default and resulting behavior or implemented handlers.
evidence.transformation: Error47 overwrite example exposes concealed unrequested loss, replacing generic labels and dangerous Return behavior with contextual recovery and explicit outcomes.
evidence.verification: Tests Return, Cancel, supported escape, large text and repeated errors without stacking; fails misleading consequence or routine informational interruption.
evidence.applicability: Retains Cancel-not-default/no-default distinction, Done versus informational OK, platform accessory limits and separate native execution evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Uses action-sheets for alternatives, undo-and-redo for reversible work and modality for the surrounding exit contract.
evidence.distinctiveness: Alert-worthy urgency and deliberate-destruction exception guide concrete defaults and copy rather than reducing alerts to a generic confirmation checklist.
